defect: loadSettings loads the new IconDownloadFallbackToGoogle setting into lockDatabaseOnScreenLockCheckBox instead of fallbackToGoogle (copy-paste error), clobbering the screen-lock checkbox and never showing the fallback setting.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added line to target fallbackToGoogle; the wrong widget name is visible in the diff next to the matching save line.

defect: The fix makes the second database unlock honour --quiet; this change only renamed Database::unlockFromStdin to Utils::unlockDatabase and kept Utils::STDOUT for db2.
reason: The unconditional STDOUT for db2 already existed before this change, so the defect was not introduced here.

defect: Misplaced parenthesis: 'if (!fileKey.load(path), &errorMsg)' calls load without the error pointer and uses the comma operator, so the condition is always true and the error message is never captured.
reason: The fix moves the parenthesis in exactly this added line; the typo is plainly visible in the diff.

defect: int(QThread::currentThreadId()) casts a pointer-sized HANDLE to int, which is a hard error (loses precision) with 64-bit MinGW/GCC, breaking the MSYS Windows build.
reason: The fix one day later replaces this added cast with reinterpret_cast<qlonglong> to fix the MSYS build; a reviewer can see a pointer cast to int in the diff.

defect: setLaunchAtStartup writes applicationFilePath() to the Run key unquoted and with forward slashes, so autostart fails for paths with spaces (e.g. Program Files) or non-native separators.
reason: The fix quotes and converts to native separators in exactly this added line; the raw Qt path in a Windows registry Run value is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix moves the file-filter patterns out of the translatable strings so translators cannot break them; this change only changed '*.*' to '*' inside an already translated string.
reason: Translating the whole filter string predates this change; the fix is a translation-robustness improvement, not a repair of something this change broke.

defect: deserialize reads attribute 'Trusted' though serialize writes 'Trust', treats QString::compare's non-zero (unequal) result as a match, and misspells 'Unrusted', so trust is never read back correctly.
reason: The fix corrects the attribute name, the '== 0' comparisons and the typo, all in lines added by this change and visible in its diff.

defect: The fix rewrites 'const auto* result = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(...)' as 'const auto result = ...', which is equivalent valid C++.
reason: The deduced declaration is legal and gives the same type, so the CryptoHash part of the 'compilation error' fix is a style change, not a repair of a defect.

defect: The benchmark lambda captures 'this' but never uses it, which triggers clang's -Wunused-lambda-capture and breaks the build under the project's -Wall -Werror flags.
reason: The fix removes the unused capture from this added lambda; the unused 'this' is visible in the diff (the -Werror setting is in CMakeLists).

defect: localServerPath builds the socket name from qApp's KPXC_QUALIFIED_APPNAME property, which only main.cpp sets, so keepassxc-proxy computes a different (empty-name) socket path than the application.
reason: The fix hardcodes the server name in this added line; seeing the mismatch requires knowing that the proxy process never sets the property.

defect: The header includes the generated ui_AgentSettingsWidget.h; the fix drops that include, adds an out-of-line destructor and adds include directories to make AUTOUIC builds work.
reason: The only includers are in the same sshagent target and the code apparently built when merged, so it is unclear whether this was a real build failure on a supported configuration or a later CMake/AUTOUIC change.

defect: Together with its CMake switch to absolute CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_* dirs, the change makes data/plugin lookup rely on hardcoded absolute install paths, which the fix reworks to also handle relocated (DESTDIR) installs.
reason: The breakage reported in the fix concerns plugin paths and DESTDIR relocation driven by the CMakeLists part of the change; the FilePath.cpp line itself works for normal installs, so attribution and support of the configuration are unclear.

defect: In Resources.cpp the fix only renames getTrayIconAppearance to trayIconAppearance and makes some getters const.
reason: The real fix (preselecting the combo-box entry) is in another file; the Resources.cpp changes are a refactor.

defect: The fix makes Windows call hideWindow() at startup too, so 'minimize at startup' respects 'hide to tray'; this change kept Windows on its existing showMinimized() path.
reason: Windows behaviour was unchanged by this change (showMinimized was already used before), so the Windows defect predates it.

defect: The fix renames the misspelled test variables 'serachAction'/'serachActionWidget'.
reason: A spelling fix of local variable names in a test is style, not a defect.

defect: The fix gives the search QMenu a parent so it is no longer leaked.
reason: The menu was already created with 'new QMenu()' and no owner before this change (setMenu does not take ownership), so the leak predates it.

defect: The fix makes testIsRecycled use a stack Database so it is no longer leaked under ASAN.
reason: The heap-allocated, never-deleted Database already existed before this change, which only replaced createRecycleBin with setRecycleBinEnabled; it is also a test-only change.

defect: The fix rewrites the syntax-check tests from QCOMPARE(true/false, ...) to QVERIFY and adds new S: token tests.
reason: This is a test refactor and extension, not a repair of a defect in the lines this change added.

defect: The fix replaces the deprecated QProcess::start(QString) overload with splitCommand + start(program, args) on Qt >= 5.15.
reason: This removes a deprecation warning (suppressed in non-dev builds); it is a cleanup, not a repair of a functional defect.

defect: The fix replaces 'return nullptr' with 'return {}' in functions returning QSharedPointer<Kdf>, which older Qt cannot convert.
reason: This change's uuidToKdf returned a raw Kdf*, where nullptr is fine; the QSharedPointer return type and kdfFromParameters came in later commits.

defect: The fix stops pre-rendering three pixmap sizes per database icon (and drops the cache limit) to reduce memory use.
reason: The three addPixmap calls and the cache limit existed before; this change only replaced enum sizes with iconSize() values.

defect: The fix shrinks recolored icons from 128x128 to 48x48 and renders on/off icons at one size to cut memory use.
reason: The 128x128 rendering and the per-size loop in onOffIcon existed before this change, which only changed how the recolor is painted.

defect: For a password plus key file, KeePass1Key::rawKey hashes the raw password bytes instead of SHA256(password), giving the wrong composite key for KeePass 1 databases.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added line to hash the password first; the asymmetry with the password-only branch is visible in the diff, given the KeePass 1 key format.

defect: The added setWindowFlags(WindowStaysOnTopHint) is called after show()/activateWindow()/raise(), which re-hides the dialog so the association popup does not appear on tiling window managers.
reason: The fix moves this added line before show(); calling setWindowFlags on a shown window is a known Qt pitfall visible in the diff.

defect: The new scheme check skips any entry whose scheme differs from the site's even when 'Match URL scheme' is off, e.g. scheme-less or http entries for an https site.
reason: The fix adds the matchUrlScheme() guard to this added condition; matchUrlScheme is used a few lines below, so the missing guard is visible in the diff.

defect: The replacement condition 'else if (m_db->hasKey())' is inverted: cancelling the key dialog closes databases that have a key and keeps ones that do not.
reason: The old test closed when the key was empty; the fix one day later adds the missing '!' to exactly this changed line.

defect: The fix replaces the confusing Yes/No lock-file question with a dialog offering Yes, No and Open read-only.
reason: This change only renamed KeePassX to KeePassXC in the message text; the confusing dialog design predates it.

defect: The fix wraps the ::write/::read calls in the signal handling in Q_UNUSED to silence unused-result warnings.
reason: The build had no -Werror at the time, so this removes compiler warnings only.

defect: The fix reorders member initializers (-Wreorder) and adds Q_UNUSED(url) in the non-HTTP build.
reason: These are warning fixes on code that also changed afterwards, not repairs of a functional defect.

defect: handleURL now accepts an entry when siteQUrl.host().endsWith(entryQUrl.host()) with no domain boundary, so an entry for example.com matches unrelated hosts like evilexample.com.
reason: The fix adds a base-domain equality check to exactly this changed line; plain suffix matching on host strings is visibly too lax in the diff.

defect: saveDatabaseAs overwrites dbStruct.lockFile without deleting the old lock (leaking it and keeping the old file locked), takes the new lock only after writing, and never asks about an existing lock.
reason: The fix rewrites the lock handling this change added to saveDatabaseAs, deleting the old lock and checking the new one first; the overwrite without delete is visible in the diff.

defect: Replacing entry->webUrl() with QUrl(entry->url()) drops the automatic scheme, so URLs stored without a scheme (e.g. example.com) no longer open in the browser.
reason: The fix changes this added line to QUrl::fromUserInput (#3259); seeing the regression requires knowing that webUrl() added the missing scheme.

defect: The fix adds braces around single-statement if/else bodies in setActive.
reason: This is a formatting fix with no behavioural change.

defect: Info.cpp uses asConst() without including core/Global.h, relying on transitive includes, so it fails to compile on some platforms.
reason: The fix one day later adds the missing include; seeing it requires knowing that asConst is defined in Global.h.

defect: The fix reworks the browser password generator popup lifecycle (QPointer, show/hide, no parent) after the QDialog-based close-button change was reverted.
reason: The broken close button and standalone generator came from the separate QDialog commits; the double ownership through QScopedPointer and deleteLater predates this change, which only passed parents.

defect: Making PasswordGeneratorWidget a QDialog instead of a QWidget breaks its embedded, standalone use: a QDialog child becomes its own window.
reason: The fix reverts the base class to QWidget because QDialog broke the standalone generator; seeing this requires knowing where the widget is embedded.

defect: The fix moves Crypto::init() from init() (run before every test) to initTestCase() to avoid 'already initialized' warnings.
reason: This is a test-only change that removes warnings; it repairs no wrong result in the product.

defect: The fix adds clickable hyperlinks to the notes in the preview panel (#3511).
reason: This is a new feature, not a repair of a defect introduced by moving group notes to the General tab.

defect: 'static const CustomData::CustomDataItem NULL_ITEM;' default-initializes a const object of a type without a user-provided constructor, which AppleClang 7/8 reject, breaking the build.
reason: The fix adds '{}' to exactly this added line; seeing it requires CustomDataItem's definition in the header.

defect: 'static const Metadata::CustomIconData NULL_ICON;' default-initializes a const aggregate without a user-provided constructor, a compile error on AppleClang 7/8.
reason: The fix adds '{}' to exactly this added line; seeing it requires CustomIconData's definition in Metadata.h.
